senses.gloss: खलीन- + आकर्षण खलीन- + आकर्षण, pulling of a bridle, Pañc. 258, 22.

† खल् खल्, i. 1, Par.
 1. To totter.
 2. To gather.
 --Cf. स्खल्.

खल्ल् खल्ल्, i. 1, Ātm. To totter, to be loose, Suśr. 1, 301, 8.
 --Cf. स्खल्.

खल खल,
 I. m. and n. A threshing-floor, Man. 11, 17.
 II. m. An oilcake, Pañc. ii. d. 53.
 III. m. and f. ला,
 1. Mischievous, Pañc. i. d. 443.
 2. Vile, Hit. ii. 43.
खल्ल खल्ल, m. A bag, Suśr. 2, 364, 4.
खलखलाय खलखलाय, [] Ātm. To fluctuate(?), Cāṇ. 72 in Monatsb. Berl. Ak. Hist. Phil. 1864, 411.

खलि खलि, m. An oil-cake; in तिल-खलि, Bhartṛ. 2, 98 (cf. Chr. p. 309), The deposit of oil prepared from sesamum.
 --Cf. खल.
खलिन खलिन, i. e. खल + इन, adj. Covered with oil-cakes(?), MBh. 13, 7288.
खलीन खलीन, m. and n. The bit of a bridle, MBh. 1, 7343; (borrowed from the Greek χαλῑνός).
खलीकार खलीकार, i. e. खल, or खलि-कृ + अ, m., and खलीकृति खलीकृति, i. e. खल or खलि-कृ + ति. f. Abuse, Kathās. 12, 175; 13, 157.

खलु खलु, a particle.
 1. Indeed, Rām. 3, 35, 32; Yājñ. 2, 64.
 2. Only, Rām. 2, 63, 37.
 3. With preceding न, Not at all, Rām. 1, 74, 21.
 4. It lays a stress on an interrogation, Śāk. 32, 11.
 5. खलु कृत्वा, Enough of this, do it no more, Pāṇ. 3, 4, 18.

खल्वाट खल्वाट, adj. Baldheaded, Bhartṛ. 2, 86.
 --Cf. खलति, and Lat. calvus.
खालित्य खालित्य (probably for खालत्य, ved., i. e. खलति + य), n. Baldness, Suśr. 1, 129, 8.
